description: Header file defining the AOTIModelContainerRunner class for managing model containers in the torch::inductor namespace, including methods for running models, updating constants, and registration of external backends.

classes.name: AOTIModelContainerRunner
classes.description: Class for managing and executing AOTI model containers, including methods for running models, updating constants, and handling model lifecycle.

classes.name: RegisterAOTIModelRunner
classes.description: Struct for registering external AOTI model backends, not thread-safe, used during program initialization.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the model container with given input tensors.

methods.name: boxed_run
methods.description: Executes the model container with ownership transfer of input tensors.

methods.name: getConstantNamesToOriginalFQNs
methods.description: Returns a map from constant names to their original fully qualified names.

methods.name: getConstantNamesToDtypes
methods.description: Returns a map from constant names to their data types.

methods.name: extract_constants_map
methods.description: Extracts constants as a map from names to tensors.

methods.name: update_inactive_constant_buffer
methods.description: Updates the buffer for inactive constants.

methods.name: update_constant_buffer
methods.description: Updates the constant buffer with provided tensors.

methods.name: run_const_fold
methods.description: Performs constant folding on the model.

methods.name: update_constant_buffer_from_blob
methods.description: Updates constants from a blob file.

methods.name: get_call_spec
methods.description: Returns the call specification as a list of strings.
